title: Login with valid credentials redirects to customer home
description: Verifies a user can log in with valid email/password and land on the customer home page.

steps.description: Navigate to /Grocessary Website/pages/auth/login.php
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the customer home page
Verify primary customer home content is displayed

title: Login with incorrect password shows authentication failure
description: Verifies an incorrect password prevents login and shows an authentication failure notification.

steps.description: Navigate to /Grocessary Website/pages/auth/login.php
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication failure notification is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

title: Login page loads and exposes primary login form controls
description: Verifies the login page loads and the email and password inputs are available for interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /Grocessary Website/pages/auth/login.php
Verify the email input field is displayed
Verify the password input field is displayed

title: Login form blocks submission with empty required fields
description: Verifies submitting the login form without required inputs shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /Grocessary Website/pages/auth/login.php
Submit the login form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

title: Email format validation appears for invalid email input
description: Verifies the login form displays a validation error when the email format is invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /Grocessary Website/pages/auth/login.php
Fill in the email field with invalid-email-format
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify an email validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page
